QUOTE: "`skipSync: true` | add path, set in `reactions.ts:21` | `sanitizeReactions` returns early at `reaction.ts:42-44`, before computing `deleteReactions`. The add path never deletes other reactions on the post. Without this flag, any local reaction absent from the payload would be marked for destruction."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says skipSync prevents deletion of other reactions on the post, and that without it local reactions absent from the single-reaction payload would be destroyed.
